/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
import tempfile

path = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
text = path.read_text()
renames = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
    'StampEvent': 'AnnotateEvent',
    'CountItems': 'TallyItems',
    'MergeParts': 'CombineParts',
    'FilterNoise': 'PruneNoise',
    'SortRecords': 'OrderRecords',
    'EncodePayload': 'MarshalPayload',
    'DecodeReply': 'ParseReply',
    'OpenChannel': 'ConnectChannel',
    'CloseChannel': 'ReleaseChannel',
    'FlushBuffer': 'DrainBuffer',
    'SaveResult': 'PersistResult',
}
for old, new in renames.items():
    text = text.replace(old, new)
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix='.workflow.', text=True)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(text)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
PY
rg -n '\\b(LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|StampEvent|CountItems|MergeParts|FilterNoise|SortRecords|EncodePayload|DecodeReply|OpenChannel|CloseChannel|FlushBuffer|SaveResult)\\b' --glob '*.go' --glob '"'!**/*_test.go'"' || true
git diff -- pipeline/workflow.go"
